```sql
SELECT
  player_id,
  player_name,
  SUM(pts) * 1.0 / SUM(played) AS points_per_game,
  SUM(reb) * 1.0 / SUM(played) AS rebounds_per_game,
  SUM(ast) * 1.0 / SUM(played) AS assists_per_game
FROM "nba_golden"."dev"."player_game_stats"
WHERE game_date >= '2017-01-01' AND game_date < '2018-01-01'
  AND (player_name = 'LeBron James' OR player_name = 'Stephen Curry')
GROUP BY player_id, player_name
LIMIT 500;
```
